sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It turns to the kid.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Who survives?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Tonight, two legends collide.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: On the left, the Vrykolakas.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: On the right, the Church Grim.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Who wins?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Comment.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A kid chases fireflies deep into the woods, until the path vanishes.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then the trees part, and an old graveyard waits.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The ground shakes, and the Vrykolakas claws its way out.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It sees the kid, and starts walking.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But Church Grim leaps the wall and blocks its path.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Garlic makes it flinch, and the headstone warns: only fire ends it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But Grim is strong only inside these walls.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Round one.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grim lunges, and his jaws close on its throat.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Claws rake his side, but he holds, and the dead man crawls away.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Round two.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It grabs Grim by the neck and hurls him over the wall.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Outside, his power dies, so every claw lands.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grim falls, and the Vrykolakas turns to the kid.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Round three.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grim crawls back inside, and his strength returns.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It charges through wild garlic, and the stench cripples it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Legend says a dog lies buried here, and Grim grows stronger.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He pounces, and one last bite ends it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Grim wins.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At dawn, Grim buries the body.

sentences.speaker: grim
sentences.text: Go home, child.

sentences.speaker: grim
sentences.text: Never come back after dark.

sentences.speaker: kid
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The kid runs home.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Next night, the kid lies in bed.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then, one knock.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Nobody burned it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Is it really dead?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Who's next?
